run_all_benchmarks: run all PyTorch3D benchmark files by executing bm_main.py with no arguments
run_specific_benchmarks: run specific benchmark files by passing bm_ prefixed filenames as arguments to bm_main.py
run_benchmark_subprocess: run a single benchmark file as a subprocess with inherited environment variables via bm_main.py
discover_benchmark_files: discover all benchmark files matching the bm_*.py pattern in the benchmarks directory
review_main_function: review the main function that orchestrates benchmark discovery and subprocess execution
